Interface TapeListener

All Superinterfaces:
FileLoader.Listener
public interface TapeListener extends FileLoader.Listener
Decoded tape callbacks for FileLoader; application state is outside this contract.

    • onTurboSpeedData

      default void onTurboSpeedData(int pilotPulseLen, int sync1PulseLen, int sync2PulseLen, int zeroBitPulseLen, int oneBitPulseLen, int pilotToneCount, int usedBitsInLastByte, int pauseAfterMs, byte[] data)
      TZX Block 0x11 - Turbo Speed Data Block. Like standard speed data but with custom timing parameters.
      Parameters:
      pilotPulseLen - length of pilot pulse in T-states
      sync1PulseLen - length of first sync pulse in T-states
      sync2PulseLen - length of second sync pulse in T-states
      zeroBitPulseLen - length of zero bit pulse in T-states
      oneBitPulseLen - length of one bit pulse in T-states
      pilotToneCount - number of pilot pulses
      usedBitsInLastByte - used bits in the last byte (1-8)
      pauseAfterMs - pause after this block in ms
      data - data bytes (including flag + data + checksum, as in TAP)
